_comment: Hand-editable group definitions for shared multi-room costumes. Each group is encoded once globally; rooms that draw any of its cids lock that group's palette slots. Groups with the SAME pal_indices SHARE slot positions — each subgroup gets its own canonical RGBs, and a per-room lookup picks which subgroup's RGBs to lock based on which cid is drawn there. Built 2026-05-08; edit freely and re-run tools/encode_global_extras.py + tools/preview_groups.py.

groups.name: extras_a
groups._note: Green-leaning subset of original extras_a (Largo's pirate gang in green coats, dancing girls, henchmen, small accessories)

groups.name: extras_b
groups._note: Warm-tone subset of original extras_a (pirates, sailors, officers, soldiers). SHARES slots [4..7] with extras_a_green and extras_a_flame — they're mutually exclusive per room (no two of these groups have a cid drawn in the same room). The optimizer is free to pick its own 4 centroids from these 8 character cids; no locks.

groups.name: extras_c
groups._note: Just cid 27 (the campfire flame). Drawn only in rooms 4 and 5. Split out from extras_a_warm so locking flame colours doesn't starve the 8 character cids.
